paper.title: De novo design of miniproteins targeting GPCRs

generators.name: RFdiffusion MPNN binder design
generators.description: Generate miniprotein binder backbones against a fixed GPCR target with RFdiffusion3, then assign sequences with ProteinMPNN.

evidence.quote: For the CXCR4 binder design, we used RFdiffusion first to generate penetrating pentamers using hotspot residues W94, I259, I284.
Following backbone design with either RFdiffusion or MetaGen we used ProteinMPNN for sequence design and AlphaFold2 (AF2) initial guess as well as Rosetta metrics for filtering designs.

constraints.name: structure ipTM filter
constraints.description: Require predicted binder-target interface confidence above threshold (AF2 pAE gate proxy).

evidence.quote: Designs that passed in silico criteria (AF2 pAE_ineraction < 15, pLDDT_binder > 75, and Rosetta ddG < −45) were next subjected to an iterative partial diffusion approach.

constraints.name: Boltz2 binding strength
constraints.description: Score predicted binding strength of the designed miniprotein against CXCR4.

evidence.quote: Designs that passed more stringent in silico criteria (pAE_interaction < 8, pLDDT_binder > 80, Rosetta ddG < −45 and sap < 60) were selected for library construction and high throughput screening.

constraints.name: protein length range
constraints.description: Keep binder within the paper's CXCR4 miniprotein length window.

evidence.quote: Per selected pentamer, 1,000 scaffolds were generated by building 0-70 residues on the N and C-termini of the central three residues. The lengths of the termini were randomly sampled but were restricted to a final total length range of 65-75 residues for each design.

optimizers.name: rejection sampling design filter
optimizers.description: Draw independent RFdiffusion+MPNN binder candidates and keep those passing structure and binding filters.

evidence.quote: 25,714 designs generated with scaffold-guided RFdiffusion ... were screened using the biofloating approach.

model_dependencies.name: RFdiffusion
model_dependencies.purpose: Motif-scaffolded and scaffold-guided miniprotein backbone generation

evidence.quote: Code for using RFdiffusion v.1.0 is available at GitHub (https://github.com/RosettaCommons/RFdiffusion#binder-design).
Sequences were designed using ProteinMPNN (10 sequences per backbone).
The structures of these designs were then predicted by AF2 initial guess.

evidence.quote: A representative RFdiffusion trajectory for generating binders (blue) against the CXCR4 (yellow, PDB ID: 4RWS). Selected hot spots are highlighted in pink.

steps.operation: ProteinMPNN sequence assignment on binder chain

evidence.quote: Designs that passed more stringent in silico criteria (pAE_interaction < 8, pLDDT_binder > 80, Rosetta ddG < −45 and sap < 60) were selected for library construction.

assumptions: RFdiffusion3 + ProteinMPNN via rfdiffusion-mpnn-binder substitutes the paper's RFdiffusion v1.0 + partial diffusion loop.
Boltz-2 structure-iptm and binding-strength constraints proxy AF2 initial-guess pAE/pLDDT and Rosetta ddG filters.
CXCR4 chain A from PDB 4RWS represents the truncated epitope used for binder design.
Rejection sampling with num_samples=10 (full) / 2 (smoke) stands in for library-scale screening of 25,714 designs.
unknowns: MetaGen metaproteome scaffold library and Rosetta RifDock are not in Proto inventory.
Motif-directed pentamer insertion and iterative partial RFdiffusion (partial_T=15, 10 iterations) are not reproduced.
OPS-RD optical pooled screening, yeast display, and biofloating HTS are experimental and out of scope.
Pharmacology, cryo-EM validation, and in vivo HSPC mobilization are not modeled.
